author: SlabSun
body:
So there are a large variety of communicaiton apps (Skype, Teamspeak, Curse, Razer comms, etc) But between all of them, I use "Discord". May be un heard of, but It's a great app! I won't bicker on about it, but you can check it out for yourself at "https://discordapp.com/". Anyways, I want to know what you guys use for your gaming, and why. I'm curious to see what you guys use.

Why I use Discord:
-Ingame overlay
-Frequent updates
-Fantastic team of developers
-Simple settings and customization
-Flush design
-Ability to suggest a feature
-Their humorous update videos
-Mobile and tablet support
-(Unbench the kench)
